app-1.4.0.what: App 1.4.0 is released on Google Play (iOS is TestFlight-only for now, so Play alone flips it). Includes mobile #137, the patient's appointment view: their pending request can be cancelled ('Cancelar pedido'), a clinic's proposed time can be accepted or declined, an upcoming scheduled/confirmed appointment offers 'Pedir remarcação' only before it starts, and cancelling means talking to the clinic.

mobile#91.what: The app asks before booking outside the working hours or on a day off, also when moving (mobile #91), in a RELEASED store build (not just merged).

mobile#95.what: The app refuses birth dates outside 1900..today (mobile #95) in a RELEASED store build (not just merged).

mobile#99.what: The app's Settings → SolvyAI (the button switch and the actions opt-in, mobile #99) is in a RELEASED store build (not just merged).

migration-115.what: Migration 115 (SolvyAI quota and the actions switch) is applied on production.

migration-116.what: Migration 116 (the database refuses birth dates outside 1900..today) is applied on production.

solvyai-live.what: SolvyAI is on for doctors in production: migration 115 applied, the budget cap set, the privacy policy names Anthropic (USA) as processor (the §5 row and §6b are gated on this; Anthropic's retention sentence in §6 MUST be filled in first), and the app's Settings → SolvyAI (mobile #99) released. Also: every action C9 names (book, move, cancel, block time, add patient, mark paid) is a SolvyAI tool on the website's route; the website's route has book, cancel, block time, mark paid, unblock, booking decisions, add patient and move (through the website's Remarcar).

mobile#111.what: The app notifies the patient (if linked to a SolvyMed account) when the clinic books (single or series), moves or cancels their appointment (mobile #111), in a RELEASED store build (not just merged).

saved-locale-live.what: Pushes reach each person in the language they chose: migration 117 (user_locales, set_my_locale, the push-target RPCs) applied on production AND the app saving its language (mobile #97) in a RELEASED store build. The website already saves its language (for the app's 7 languages) and reads the targets once 117 exists.

mobile#116.what: In the app only scheduled / confirmed / late appointments change date or time; others show the date read-only, and an absent one offers Nova consulta pre-filled (mobile #116), in a RELEASED store build (not just merged).

linked-bookings.what: Appointments of a linked patient carry their account however they were made (migration 119, mobile #117: a trigger filling patient_auth_id from the linked record, the backfill and the fill on later linking) applied on production: until then pushes only reach patients on appointments they booked in the app.

line-live.what: LINE notices for Thai clinics are live in production: migrations 114, 122 (the 90-day delivery-history purge), 124 and 125 (notices in the recipient's saved language) applied, the LINE channel secret in Vault, the flag and webhook on, and the app's connect/disconnect flow released. Gates the privacy policy's LINE row (§5), the §6 sentence and §6c.

import-extras-live.what: Imported data is live: migration 131 (patient_import_extras, get_patient_import_extra, access kind 'imported') is applied on production AND the app build with "Dados importados" on the patient (mobile feat/import-extra-app) is released on Google Play.

merge-patients-live.what: Merging duplicate patients is live: migration 133 (merge_patients / merge_patients_preview, access kind 'merged') is applied on production AND the app build with "Mesclar com outro paciente…" (mobile feat/merge-patients-app) is released on Google Play.

patient-import-live.what: The patient import is live: migrations 130 (staging + validation) and 131 (commit + undo, patient_import_extras, patients.archived_reason) are applied on production. Gates the website import (Pacientes → Importar pacientes, the archived-reason labels) and Help P13.

notice-outbox-live.what: The patient notice outbox is about to go live: migration 135 (enqueue_patient_notice / cancel_patient_notice, the ~1-minute hold, the 30-day delivery record with its purge) is applied on production. Flip this and deploy BEFORE the sender is switched on (the function's Vault secret set LAST, per 38's runbook), so privacy §6e is published before any notice waits or is recorded.

merge-web-live.what: Mesclar pacientes on the website: migration 133 (merge_patients / merge_patients_preview) is applied on production AND the web tester's 133 rows are 🟢 there (testers force this condition in a local build to test on prod). Flip by hand, never automatically (9a / 38). Independent of the app (UX: the web may launch first). Gates "Mesclar com outro paciente…" (together with its probe) and Help P12 with the website's steps; the app's steps wait on merge-patients-live.
